alt: An array with a left pointer and a right pointer starting at opposite ends. Each step swaps the two pointed-at values, then moves both pointers one slot inward, until they meet (an odd-length array) or cross (an even-length one) with the array fully reversed.

steps.caption: left starts at index 0 (1), right starts at index 4 (5).
Swap positions 0 and 4: they now hold 5 and 1. Both pointers step one slot inward.
left is now at index 1, right is now at index 3.
Swap positions 1 and 3: they now hold 4 and 2. Both pointers step one slot inward.
left and right meet at the same slot. The array is fully reversed: [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].
left starts at index 0 (1), right starts at index 3 (4).
Swap positions 0 and 3: they now hold 4 and 1. Both pointers step one slot inward.
left is now at index 1, right is now at index 2.
Swap positions 1 and 2: they now hold 3 and 2. Both pointers step one slot inward.
left and right cross without a middle slot. The array is fully reversed: [4, 3, 2, 1].
A single element has no partner to swap with; it is already its own reverse.
left and right meet at the same slot. The array is fully reversed: [7].
